{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter for completed orders
completed_data = data[data['status'] == 'completed'].copy()

# Parse revenue as float after stripping commas
completed_data['revenue_numeric'] = completed_data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for fake QA orders (revenue >= 1,000,000)
fake_orders = completed_data[completed_data['revenue_numeric'] >= 1000000.00]

# Since no fake orders are found, use all completed orders
clean_data = completed_data.copy()

# Cross-tabulate channel and customer_segment to check for confounding
confounding_check = pd.crosstab(clean_data['channel'], clean_data['customer_segment'])

# Compute conversion rate by channel and segment
conversion_by_channel_segment = clean_data.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().reset_index()

# Compute weighted average conversion rate per channel (weighted by segment count)
segment_counts = clean_data.groupby('channel')['customer_segment'].count().reset_index(name='count')
channel_conversion = conversion_by_channel_segment.merge(segment_counts, on='channel')
channel_conversion['weighted_conversion'] = channel_conversion['converted'] * channel_conversion['count']
weighted_sum = channel_conversion['weighted_conversion'].sum()
total_count = channel_conversion['count'].sum()
weighted_avg_conversion = weighted_sum / total_count

# Extract channel-level conversion rates
email_avg = channel_conversion[channel_conversion['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].iloc[0]
paid_search_avg = channel_conversion[channel_conversion['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].iloc[0]
conversion_diff = paid_search_avg - email_avg
conversion_diff_pct = conversion_diff * 100  # in percentage points

# Final output
print(f'Final conversion rate difference (paid_search - email): {conversion_diff_pct:.2f} percentage points')

# Return the value
conversion_diff_pct"}
